sections.heading: Limitations as to Use
sections.body: The policy covers use of the vehicle for any purpose other than hire or reward, carriage of goods (other than samples or personal luggage), organised racing, pace making, speed testing, reliability trials, or any purpose in connection with the motor trade. Use for official purposes of the insured company by its employees is covered.

sections.heading: Persons or Classes of Persons Entitled to Drive
sections.body: Any person including the insured, provided that the person driving holds an effective driving licence at the time of the accident and is not disqualified from holding or obtaining such a licence. Provided also that the person holding an effective learner's licence may also drive the vehicle when not used for transport of passengers, and such person satisfies the requirements of Rule 3 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989.
